Name: CP - Molamole's Farm Kitchen
Author: MolaMole
Description:
Here some Vanilla[b] Farm Kitchen[/b] textures! to match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24116][AT x CP] - Molamole's Artisan and Refining Craftables Retextures[/url] Mod[i], [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35163][CP] Molamole's Countertops And Cabinets[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27122][AT x CP] Molamole's Wallpaper & Flooring textures.[/url]﻿
With 3 Oven styles, swatches -for Wood, Tiles, Countertops, Drawers- and themed kitchenware sets!

[b][s][size=3][ Known issues][/size][/s][/b]
None (for now), let a comment if there's any problem!
-
[b]Remember there are furniture packs, Extensions - like SVE- and Recolors [b]with a kitchen retexture[/b], check it before report it like a bug![/b]
